fusions.name: Leaping Loop
fusions.desc: Throws a looping stitch that deals 4 damage to the first enemy it meets, then leaps to 2 more enemies within 3 tiles for 60% of the damage each.

fusions.name: Knotwork Cordon
fusions.desc: Throws loops of knotted thread around you, dealing 10 damage to every enemy within 3 tiles with a 50% chance to leave each [Slowed] for 3 seconds. Your afflictions on each spread to enemies within 3.5 tiles.

fusions.name: Laced Ranks
fusions.desc: Laces every ally within 5 tiles together for 10 seconds: each strikes 15% harder and fights with 1 more Power.

fusions.name: Unbreakable Knot
fusions.desc: Your afflictions take hold on enemies that are immune to them.
